preamble: Debuccalization of the aspirated stop [tʰ] to [h] keeps only the aspiration. In Middle Indo-Aryan, intervocalic Sanskrit aspirates became h (kathayati > Prakrit kahei > Hindi kahnā 'to say'), and in the Northern Min variety of Jianyang Proto-Min initial *tʰ became h- (天 'sky').

examples.note: Initial *th became h in Jianyang; Xiamen keeps tʰ (Proto-Min article, sample table).
Shauraseni has the intermediate voiced form kadhedi

sources: Norman, J. (1988). Chinese. Cambridge University Press.
Pischel, R. (1900). Grammatik der Prakrit-Sprachen. Trübner.
